newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: VA Tech sells licence to Kobe Stl.
newsitem.headline: VA Tech sells licence to Kobe Stl.

text.p: Austrian Energy, a subsidiary of engineering group VA Technologie, said on Monday it had sold a licence for its fixed bed coke filter to Kobe Steel Corp of Japan.
The licence package allows Kobe Steel to sell the Austrian Energy technology on the whole Japanese market. No price details were made available.
Fixed bed coke filters are mainly used for the separation of organic trace elements, such as dioxines, furanes and PCB, that are formed during combustion.
Austrian Energy said in a statement its technology guarantees the lowest emissions during waste incineration.
The sale to Kobe Steel, one of Japan's top five steelmakers, represents the third licensing of Austrian Energy know how to Japanese companies. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 531 12256
